newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 4c to 627c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 4c to 627c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose four cents to 627 cents a kg clean on Wednesday at sales in Newcastle and Melbourne, Wool International said.
Merino fleece was unchanged or dearer, with 19/24/26 microns unchanged, 20/21/23/25m 0.5 percent dearer, and 22m one percent dearer, while merino skirtings were fully firm.
In crossbreds, 27/28m were slightly dearer, 29m unchanged, and 30/31m slightly cheaper, WI said.
WI said Japan, Italy and China were principal buyers, with support from local mills and most sectors.
Of the 22.388 bales offered, 4.9 percent were passed in.
Sales continue Thursday in Newcastle, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 34,300 bales to be offered.
